title: 基于智能体的农业生态模型中决策规则的敏感性分析
summary: 该研究针对智能体农业生态模型中参数呈决策树结构、经典全局敏感性分析方法不适用的问题，将决策结构作为建模对象，用代理模型把MAELIA平台的作物管理流程编码为分层设计空间，提出随机森林监督的HSIC-ANOVA方法，在树上直接排序主效应与交互作用，并应用于氮淋失、土壤有机碳变化和产量预测。
summary_en: Agent-based agro-ecological models need sensitivity analysis to find which decisions drive behavior, but their parameters form a decision tree rather than a flat vector, making classical global sensitivity analysis ill-posed. The authors encode MAELIA's crop-management itinerary as a hierarchical design space and propose a random-forest-supervised HSIC-ANOVA that ranks main effects and interactions natively on the tree, applied to nitrogen leaching, soil organic carbon change, and yield.
